净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Use size style gates to apply different value signals: larger caps use earnings yield (more stable), smaller caps use book yield with leverage penalty to mitigate distress risk. This conditions value on size through regime-specific value expressions with a distress control.

因子路由 / 公式

MYDSL(size_gated_value_leverage)
依赖列: pe_ttm, pb_lf, debttoassets, style_gate_size_large, style_gate_size_small

字段含义说明

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
flex_maxmax(x,y) 逐点比较；max(x,n) 滚动最大值

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 cheapness_pe：1.0 / pe_ttm
  2. 计算 cheapness_pb：1.0 / pb_lf
  3. 计算 leverage_penalty：1.0 - debttoassets / 100.0
  4. 计算 is_large：style_gate_size_large == 1
  5. 计算 is_small：style_gate_size_small == 1
  6. 计算 factor：cheapness_pe.copy()
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

列名含义说明

pb_lfPB 市净率 (last_filed)最新披露市净率 = price / 每股净资产
debttoassets资产负债率总负债 / 总资产

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_size_gated_value_leverage(df): df_copy = df.copy() cheapness_pe = 1.0 / df_copy["pe_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) cheapness_pb = 1.0 / df_copy["pb_lf"].replace(0, np.nan) leverage_penalty = 1.0 - df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0 is_large = df_copy["style_gate_size_large"] == 1 is_small = df_copy["style_gate_size_small"] == 1 factor = cheapness_pe.copy() factor[is_small] = (cheapness_pb * leverage_penalty)[is_small] factor.name = "factor_size_gated_value_leverage" "kw">class="kw">return factor
